THREE THINGS EVERY LANE SHOULD USE RATHER THAN REBUILD: (1) PAYMENT STATES ALREADY EXIST, pushed at 9f17132 on lane/s6-request-quote-payment-20260820: the eight-state lifecycle payment_required -> instructions_presented -> proof_submitted -> under_review -> paid|rejected|exception -> refunded lives in shared/research/assisted-order/payment-contract.ts + server/research/assisted-order/payment/**. Do not write a second payment state machine. For 'unpaid cannot fulfill' use isSettledPaymentState() (true for exactly ONE state, deliberately FALSE for refunded) or isRequestFulfillmentReady() in server/research/assisted-order/conversion/gate.ts - do NOT re-derive 'paid enough' from a list of state names, which is exactly how proof_submitted gets read as settlement. Proof is not payment: a customer can reach exactly one state and  is not a field any input can spell. (2) ELIGIBILITY GATE for 'may this variant take money': canonicalPaymentEligibility(facts, policy) in server/research/early-access/release/canonical-payment-eligibility.ts. It takes NO price amount (only a hasApprovedRetailPrice boolean) so it cannot be where a wrong number enters, and it has NO input for supplier/inventory/lot/COA/fulfillment readiness because the founder's rule 5 says those must not block ACCEPTING an order. If you need to hold an order for operations, hold it in FULFILLMENT state with an honest status; never push readiness back into the accept path. (3) THE DUPLICATE-PRICE ESCALATION IS ANSWERED - stop treating it as blocked on Samuel. The pairs disagree on CLASSIFICATION as well as price (GRP-0426 RUO 49.00 vs GRP-0402 pending 62.50; GRP-0425 RUO 59.00 vs GRP-0407 pending 107.50), so the collapse decides buyability not just price. Only one resolution satisfies BOTH founder targets: 111 direct requires GRP-0425/0426 to survive (retiring them gives 109), and 27 unique pending requires exactly GRP-0402/0407 to be the two retired. KEEP THE RUO ROW, RETIRE THE PENDING TWIN: 49.00 Hexarelin 5mg, 59.00 Oxytocin 10mg, both direct. Three tests pin it at the SHA above, so a different collapse turns the suite red. Nothing is mispriced today: runtime carries only the pending twins (approval_required); the RUO rows and GRP-0422 have no runtime variant, so the hazard is latent and fires when s7's reconciliation generates variants.
